paite: Huchi in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a;
heading: TOUPA'N Jerusalem Atungding Ding

paite: "Hichibang in sepaihte! TOUPA'N achi: Thikthusetak in Zion ka deihthoh a, nakpitak a hehna toh amah a ding in phatuam ka ngai hi," chi in.
Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zion ah kiksak in ka om a, Jerusalem lai ah ka teng ding; Jerusalem bel Thutak khopi, sepaihte' TOUPA tang, tang siangthou akichi ding hi.
Hichi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Jerusalem kongzingte ah putekte leh pitekte ahong khosa ding ua, a-upat ziak un akhut uah chiangkhun akhun chiat ding uh.
Khopi kongzingte a kimawl in numei leh pasal naupangte adim ding hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' ToUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang a hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte mit a lamdang ahihleh, kei mit ah leng alamdang sam kei dia hia? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, suahlam gam a kipan leh tumlam gam a kipan, ka mite ka hondam ding hi.
Amau ka hon pikhawm ding a, Jerusalem lai ah ateng ding ua; ka mite ahi ding uh, thutak leh diktatna ah, a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "TOUPA' inn suangphum phum ni a kipan a hiai nite a zawlneite kam a kipan a hiai thu zate'n, tempul akilam theihna ding in noute khut hatsak un.

Huai nite malam a mihing a dia kilohna a-om louh a, aganta dia leng kilohna a-om sam louh ziak in; melma ziak in apawtkhia hiam hong lut hiam a ding in leng muanna himhim a-omsak kei a, mi tengteng michih a-invengte dou in ka koih hi.
Himahleh tu in zaw hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte tung ah tuma lam nite bang in ka om kei ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.

Huan haichi pawi a om ding ahi ngal a; grepgui in agah asuang ding a, leitung in apung a-omsak ding a, vante'n adaitui uh ape ding uh; huchi in hiai mite lak a omlaite hiai thil tengteng ka luahsak ding hi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, namte lak a hamsia na hih tak bang un, Aw Judah inkote leh Israel inkote, huchibang mah in nou ka hon hondam ding a; vualzawlna na hi ding uh; lau kei un, himahleh na khutte uh hatsak un."
Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Na pipute un ahon hihheh lai ua, na tung ua gilou hih ding ka tup bang in, huchi in ka nem tuan kei, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi:
Huchi in Jerusalem tung leh Judah inkote tung ah hoih hih ding tulai nite in ka tum nawnta hi; lau kei un.
Na hih ding uh thil hiaite ahi: Michih in a-invengte toh thutak kihilh un; na kongpite uah thutak leh lemna vaihawmna hih un;
na lak ua kuamah in a-invengte siatna ding na lungtang uah gilou ngaihtuah kei un; thuchiam diklou deih kei un; hiaite tengteng ka thil huat lam ahi uh," TOUPA'N achi.
Huan sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi,
heading: Namdangte'n TOUPA Azong Ding

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Kha lina an ngawlna, ngana an ngawlna, sagihna an ngawlna leh sawmna an ngawlna, Judah inkote a ding in nopna leh kipahna, ankuangluina vualnopna ahi ding hi; huaiziak in thutak leh lemna deih in," chi in.
Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang in ahong om lai ding, mite leh khopi tampite a pan ahong pai ding ua;
huan, khopi khat a teng mite khopi dang a tengte kiang ah apai ding ua, TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding leh sepaihte' TOUPA zong ding in kintak in kuan ni; kei leng ka kuan ding, achi ding uhi.
Ahi, mi tampite leh nam hatte Jerusalem a TOUPA sepaihte zong ding leh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in ahong kuan ding uhi.

Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, namte pau tengteng a kipan mi sawm in Juda mipa puanten alen ding ua, na kiang ah ka pai ding uh, na kiang ah Pathian a-om chih ka za ngal ua, achi ding uh," chi in.
